purpose: Wallets controlled by the team, test buyers, the user, or self-payments that trigger directory indexing. A payment whose payer (the `from` of the USDC Transfer event, not tx.from) is listed here does NOT count as an external paid call.

addresses.note: Base Sepolia end-to-end test buyer (scripts/e2e-sepolia.ts). Key kept outside the repo.
Testnet payTo used for local end-to-end runs. Not the mainnet receiving address.

Base mainnet payTo (receiving wallet). A Transfer from payTo to payTo is a self-payment for directory indexing (r16). Key in AWS Secrets Manager x402/payto-wallet, ap-northeast-1.
